events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: His partner rode north. Yours rode into your grass. I'll take yours.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: That's one file I get to close honest.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Steady pay and a straight answer. I've worked for worse reasons.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: I don't say things twice, so listen the first time: I'm glad you asked.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Three counties of paper on one man, and he was already in the ground. Nobody tells you that part.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Cobb still asks if I'm coming back. I still tell him no. We're both comfortable with the ritual.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Marsh sold me a dead man's paper once. I don't buy from him anymore. I still owe him a conversation about it.
